nom: VANICREAM Cleansing Bar for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: Very gentle cleansing bar that does not strip my skin of moisture. It feels hydrated and clean. Love it.

avis.titre: Cleans without making your skin dry!
avis.texte: I have been using this daily in the shower. It lathers well and definitely leaves me feeling clean. I appreciate that it is fragrance free as some fragrance can really bother me. It is gentle and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry like other soaps.
My skin didn't have any reactions like it usually does. Stayed hydrated and didn't dry out! Absolutely will be a repeat buyer!

I've been using the Vanicream Cleansing Bar for several weeks and have been very pleased with the results. The bar creates a gentle lather that cleanses effectively without leaving my skin feeling tight, dry, or irritated. One of the things I appreciate most is that it is fragrance-free and free of many common irritants, making it a great option for sensitive skin. After using it consistently, my skin felt clean, soft, and comfortable. It rinses away easily without leaving any residue and works well for both face and body. I also noticed that it helped maintain my skin's natural moisture balance compared to some other cleansing products I've tried. The bar is long-lasting, easy to use, and suitable for daily cleansing. I would recommend the Vanicream Cleansing Bar to anyone looking for a mild, effective cleanser, especially those with sensitive, dry, or easily irritated skin. Overall, this is an excellent product that delivers on its promises, and I would happily purchase it again.
I've been using this soap for about a month, its ok. I dont see any significant improvement in my skin.

I have extremely sensitive skin on my hands. This soap didn't make my hands itch and break out, but it did dry them out really bad. I was expecting soap that doesn't smell, but this turned my stomach.

I tried vanicream soap bar for the first time and one thing I noticed as I opened the box was the smell. Not a big fan if how it smells and I didn't feel a big difference from the soap bar I was using previously.

I really liked it; it was especially helpful when I had my surgery and needed that soap. A thousand thanks—I will definitely buy it again because I really liked it, and it helped with my son's sensitive skin as well as with my surgery.

I have incredibly sensitive skin and am allergic to most bar soaps. Using scented or "moisturizing" soaps result in a painful rash on my chest and back. My five year old son has also unfortunately inherited this allergy. This soap is a game changer! My normal day to day soap absolutely strips my skin of all moisture. For the first time in my adult life I found a soap that left my skin feeling soft and didn't require me to slather my entire body in lotion after showering. I love that this soap leaves me feeling so soft! Both my son and I are able to use this soap with zero allergic reaction. Bonus, I can also use it as a face wash.

This Cleansing Bar by Vanicream is such an amazing product. It's free from harsh ingredients. Free of dyes, fragrance, lanolin and parabens which is great for our skin. I'm so happy that this product is suitable for sensitive skin. I highly recommend this product to everyone.
I've enjoyed this soap. It doesn't feel like it's drying my skin out but doesn't feel like it's not cleaning. It's basic and does what it needs to do effectively.

I need to start by saying that I suffer from very dry skin,very oily skin and also psoriasis on my face. I have the hardest time trying to find products that are able to help with all of these issues. This Vanicream bar was great for me. It took care of the oily skin as well as dry skin without irritating my delicate skin even more. It didn't leave me needing anything more in my morning routine. It didnt leave any residue or strip my natural skin whatsoever. The only complaint I have is I didnt care for the scent. It is not scented but it had an unpleasant light smell to me personally. I tend to go for something with a light clean scent, but that is only my person opinion and does not reflect the performance of the product. I will definitely purchase this again.
It works great for me I have very sensitive skin and it felt none irradiated

I used this on my face and broke out big time. I'm not sure why this happened but I got four big boils on my face. I wouldn't purchase Thai and I don't have sensitive skin. I've used other vanicream items I think this one just didn't mix well for me.
It is a very good product. I love that it was fragrance free and gentle to use. It was not drying at all which is something I've dealt with using bar soap.

I love this cleansing bar. It is so gentle on the skin yet it moisturizes and hydrates my skin I suffer from itching on my hands and face during the spring. This bar helps enormously. I highly recommend it to everyone. I did receive this product for free as a sample but my opinions are my own. It works !!

I have pretty sensitive skin and am always hesitant to try a new brand. I typically always lean towards products that are fragrance free and as minimal ingredients as possible. This cleansing bar met my standard and did a great job! I've used it for a week now and haven't broken out anywhere. I've used even used it on my eczema prone son! Highly recommend for clean, fragrance free cleanser.
I've been using the Vanicream Cleansing Bar for a few weeks and love it. It cleans my skin without leaving it dry or tight. Perfect for sensitive skin and completely fragrance free.
The soap is scent free which is great for sensitive skin! The bar lasts a long time which is nice as well. My whole family can use this product which is also a bonus!

Thank you Vanicream for sending me this free product to try! I have been a fan of the Vanicream skin care line for a while now, thanks to my husband's dermatologist recommendation. My husband and daughter (age 10) both have sensitive skin that tends to get rashes easily. They have been using vanicream daily moisturizer which helps give moisture to their skin but I did notice once we added the vanicream cleansing bar soap it completely cleared their skin. It left it looking nice and smooth and cleared any skin impurities they had. I tried it as well and I can truly say its a nice gentle soap that leaves your skin feeling clean and soft. I would definitely be adding this to my family's daily skin care products!

I have really enjoyed using this product. I have rosacea and sensitive skin and this did not flare up my skin. After cleansing my face it always feels soft and smooth, it is such a perfect everyday product!
Easy and simple to use. Made face so clear even after one ise. Feels so much cleaner than normal face washes

I received a free sample in exchange for my honest opinion. I love this soap. It cleaned very well. It works good with my son's sensitive skin. It soaks up well and has no negative fragrance. I'm happy with this new great find.

I truly love this product. Typically, I use body washes, but since I got this in is a free sample.I decided to give it again. I normally keep dry skin, especially around the summer, with being outside and all. And this helped to lock in moisture and not create any kind of skin irritants. I would also feel comfortable using this.On my toddler.For skin as well.

Excellent product for people with skin sensitivity, I loved it because it feels a feeling of freshness and calm after using it, especially because it has no fragrance that can alter the ph of my skin.
Lathers very well and great if you're looking for a gentle cleanser. I love that it's baby friendly so the whole family can benefit from using this product. It's a must buy!

I used the soap for my body and then I tried it on my face and I loved it! It never dried out my skin. It lathers great. The bar itself is a really good size and there's only a clean smell which I can appreciate. Leaves my body feeling soft and really goes a long way. I highly recommend

I love that this cleansing bar is fragrance-free because it makes it easy to use all over the body. It doesn't leave behind that filmy feeling on your skin after using it, which I really appreciate. I've been using it on my whole body, including my face, and my skin is usually sensitive to certain facial cleansers and even some body washes. So far, I haven't had any reactions at all — just a fresh, clean feeling without the residue that many cleansers tend to leave behind.
Great for cleansing in bathroom. Can use all over body and face, easy to use and effective product definitely recommend for a reliable choice! I would buy this again and recommend to anyone looking

Unlike cheap bar soaps that leave skin itchy or dry, this Vanicream Cleansing Bar cleans thoroughly without stripping moisture. I like that it's made of hypoallergenic ingredients, and it leaves the body clean while staying extremely gentle, and it works well on both face and body in one step. It's fragrance-free and free of harmful chemicals and it soothes the redness on my skin, which makes it noticeably calmer for sensitive skin. Its shape is easy to hold and lasts for many showers.

I am beyond impressed this really is sensitive and gentle and fragrance free as someone who struggles to find all three of those with boxes check this checked every box and gave me the cleanest feeling without feeling like I was in fragrance.

I love this vanicream cleansing bar! It is moisturizing and feels great on the skin. It is a great cleanser and I would buy this product again and recommend it to others. It is also a decently sized soap bar.

I love washing my body with bars of soaps, and nothing beats this vanicream cleansing bar. I love that it's both cleansing and moisturizing, without added items that aren't necessary. I know by using this product I am using something that is good for my skin as well as my family's.

avis.titre: Highly recommend! Great lather and fresh feel
avis.texte: I am genuinely impressed with the Vanicream™ Cleansing Bar. It has a very pleasant, clean scent that isn't overpowering at all. The bar lathers up beautifully into a rich, creamy foam, leaving my skin feeling incredibly clean and fresh without that tight, dry feeling. It performs much better than other cleansing bars I've tried in the past. I highly recommend it to my friends and family, and I will definitely be purchasing it again! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
I love how clean and refreshed my skin feels with only a few uses
Definitely recommend for anyone especially who has sensitive skin!
Works really well for my 3 yr old eczema prone skin. It cleans toddler grime off his body, without stripping, and doesn't dry it at all. No new eczema flares.
People need to realize that fragrances are not good if your endocrine system. This is what everybody needs to switch to. Great product, worth every penny.

avis.titre: I would buy it, and I would buy it again.
avis.texte: I absolutely loved using it; after washing my face, my skin felt incredibly clean, fresh, and soft. I have oily skin, and it left my complexion looking perfect.
I have been using this soap on my face the last 4 night and my face feels so refreshed and soft. I also love the natural smell of the soap. It's a great soap.

avis.titre: Finally a cleanser that doesn't dry my skin out
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin, and I've definitely noticed a difference since using the Vanicream Cleansing Bar. It leaves my skin feeling clean and soft without irritation or dryness. I honestly think it works better for my skin than Dove. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle cleanser for sensitive skin.

When getting a bar soap, I have flashbacks to the terrible residue they leave, but not with Vanicream! It was an easy lather, without flying out of my hands, and left me feeling clean with zero residue! My body felt moisturised, not dry, after use and I'm so surprised with how much I enjoyed this!
Great gentle cleanser—effective without drying out my skin. Perfect for sensitive skin and leaves my face feeling clean and comfortable. Love that it's fragrance-free!
I got the chance to use this base today and I loved it, it got my face so clean, I purposely used a white towel to see all the gunk that came off.

avis.titre: Gentle Cleansing Bar That Doesnt Dry Out the Skin
avis.texte: Picked this up after my wife mentioned wanting a gentler option for daily cleansing and the bar format made sense for keeping things simple. Right out of the box the bar feels solid and substantial, has a clean white color without any added dyes or coloring. The packaging is straightforward without unnecessary excess. The bar itself has a smooth texture that lathers up well when used with warm water, creating a creamy foam that spreads easily without needing to scrub aggressively. Working the lather across the face and body is gentle, no scratchy or rough texture pulling at the skin. The bar rinses clean without leaving any waxy residue or filmy buildup like some bars tend to do. The skin feels comfortable after rinsing, not stripped or tight which is something that bothered me with regular soap bars. The fragrance free formula is appreciated, no overpowering scent that lingers or competes with other skincare products in the routine. The lack of dyes and unnecessary additives is another plus, the ingredient list is reasonable for what it is. The bar holds up well between uses when stored in a soap dish that drains properly, doesnt turn into a mushy mess overnight. The size lasts a decent amount of time with daily use, gets through several weeks before needing replacement. The shape is easy to grip even with wet hands, doesnt slip out as easily as some thinner bars. Works fine for both face and body use which simplifies things during showers. The clean rinsing means it doesnt

I recieved this as a free gift and loved it! It cleans the body really well and has helped me to get rid of body acne. I usually have trouble with bar soaps since they lead my skin to feel itchy but so far i have used it for a month and no issues at all. It also does not make my skin so dry after but does keep it so smooth.

I absolutely love this bar soap! I've always had an issue with dry itchy skin, and I've tried many different brands. However, not many of them are as clean as they say they are. I realized that certain brands have masking fragrances that irritate my skin. Thank you Vanicream for making a product for a true sensitive skin. After doing research, I was surprised to find that this was made by pharmacist because I graduate this year to become a pharmacist so that's inspiring!! I will always support! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
I use this soap daily and love it! It lathers well and doesn't dry my skin. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I used this as a face wash when I ran out of my liquid one and was so surprised how well my skin reacted to this. Having dehydrated, eczema-prone, and comb skin, it helped with my flare ups while leaving my skin feel smooth and hydrated. If you're wearing makeup, this works better after a first cleanse. Bonus that it also works as a body wash and comes in a more environmental, cardboard packaging

I just started using the cleansing bar. During the day I use the facial moisturizer with hyaluronic acid and ceramides, the Vanicream cream ( over the moisturizer) and the facial spf 30 on top. I need all 3 moisturizers for my very dry skin. I think the cleansing bar does a very good job at removing the products at night ( esp the sunscreen). My go-to facial hydrating cleanser was good but never seemed to completely remove the sunscreen. I do think the cleansing bar is slightly drying but it prepares my skin well for the application of the moisturizers at the same time. I've only been using it for a week. I have very sensitive, fair, thin skin and mild rosacea (just redness). The cleansing bar seems to minimize the redness though it will likely not eliminate it. After cleansing at night I rub a good amount of the Vanicream cream on my face and follow with a thin layer of Vaseline. I've been using only Vanicream on my face for about 9 months. I'm 65. A few people have told me recently that I have beautiful skin! So I'm not switching to anything else! I'm staying with Vanicream!!

avis.titre: Best bar soap for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: This is great for sensitive skin. I can use it head to toe. It has a rich creamy later that doesnt strip my skin. I've bought dozens over the years. I can't say enough good things.

avis.titre: Works great, wished it came in bulk
avis.texte: Every other soap or body wash I have used has irritated me or has broke me out, especially soaps with scents. Even Dial was too harsh on my skin. Vanicream is very gentle and unscented. It is also very good for feminine hygiene unlike Dove or Olay. Moisturizing and great to pair with their lotion. I just wished they sold these in a pack rather than individually.
Almost every other product line besides this one burns my skin leaving me puffy and red. I am so grateful that this product line works great for my skin.

This product is a life saver!!!! I use this on myself and my 2 kids aged 2&5. We all have extremely sensitive eczema prone skin that is easily irritated. This is the ONLY product that we have used that does not cause any sort of reaction or irritation .I've spent thousands trying to find a product that works for us and finally found this and will NEVER use anything else. We use it as an all-in-1 head- to- toe and it works wonderful even in our hard water. Please don't ever discontinue this product! I would 110% recommend to anyone
Been using this soap for years and I can't say enough good things about it. Recommended by Dermatologist from U of Pennsylvania Medical Center.

avis.titre: Best soap I've used for dry face w rosacea
avis.texte: I've used this for about 4 years on face. It's amazing for dry skin with red bumps called rosacea. Finally my face doesn't burn with this amazing bar. I bought it while in Rochester, MN and now I see what people are talking about. Great bar to clean my face and intimate area.
I have been using Vanicream bars for years. I have a very dry, thin skin (Sjogren's syndrome) Only product I can use without drying my skin or itching.
I have extremely sensitive skin and this is the only thing I can use. I love that it also lathers up unlike most sensitive skin soaps there it leaves you feeling clean.

I am pet sitting at a client's house and they left me clean towels and a bar of vanicream . It's the first time I've used it and I really like it and I will be changing from what I am now using to vanicream .
I love this soap I have three kids with eczema. I started using it for them and it cleared it up with a few weeks. I would tell anybody whom is thinking this product that it's well worth it.
my dermatologist recommend it for a reason, cause she's smarter than me. I ordered 12 bars. Plan on using it for ever.
I used the soap bar of vanicream and it hurt my skin and eyes they burn so I will not use or recommend this product to anyone !!!
Great for sensitive skin. I like how it's for the face not just body. It's gentle and has nice simple ingredients. Love love love this bar.

I have rosacea. I'm also 58 years old. I was told by my Dermatologist not to use anti-aging product's on my face. I love the Cleansing Bar because it leaves my skin soft, doesn't irritate, and I like to use a wash cloth instead of my fingers to wash my face. I think it feels cleaner....just don't rub too hard. I have also used the Lotion for my moisturizer during the daytime under my primer and before makeup. It absorbs great and works beautifully on my skin. I use the lotion on my elbows also. GREAT PRODUCTS!

I have extremely sensitive skin.... I was having a problem & went to my Dermatologist.... He suggested Vani products. I have been using the soap bar, the liquid cleanser & the mild moisturizer for about 2 years. The only trouble I have had is actually having an easy time finding the various products.

I love this soap! Use it on face, hands and body. Is nice and creamy. Leaves skin feeling soft and smooth. I do use the Vanicream lite lotion on face, hands and body, also. No irritation and no acne breakouts.

I was have an issue with a recurring rash for the last six months. My primary doctor couldn't figure out what was causing it. We tried steroid cream and oral steroids as well. It would clear up somewhat with the oral steroids but as soon as was off of them it would come right back. I went to see an allergist and he gave me samples of the Vanicream products and within 2 days of their use the rash was clearing up. I will continue to use. Thanks for making a great product!
I love love it's creamy texture & I never have to worry about break outs ( rashes)

avis.titre: Great for getting rid of acne
avis.texte: I was using a high end skin care routine and it worked for a bit but it was WAY too much products and eventually made me break out. I love this soap bar! It not only moistrizes my skin but it gets rid of the pesky breakouts without TONS of chemicals. Less is more!
I just found out I am allergic – literally – to every product in my bathroom. This is the soap the doctor recommended and it works just fine and is not too expensive.

Very happy with this soap for myself and my kids. I love the safe ingredients, and as a pharmacist am proud to tell people the backstory. I also recommend it and the cream to my patients. I wish there was an option to buy in bulk, either online or in the store!
I really do love this soap. I prefer bar soap to liquid soap but usually they dry me out and make my skin feel tight. This is gentle and effective and not drying at all.

My doctor recommended the cleansing bar three years ago. I have always had trouble with breakouts, and allergic reactions to other face cleansers. Vanicream cleansing bar has truly been my life saver. My face is clean and clear! I also love the moisturizer cream and lotion.
It cleared up my skin, and got rid of my blackheads. ? This is the only thing that has worked.

avis.titre: The only soap I can use.

My hands were so painful I was near having to claim a disability because I couldn't use my hands. I am so thankful for this company and its products. I can't thank them enough. Don't change a thing.

Keeps my skin free of dryness, irritation, and redness. Skin feels really clean like having a daily mini-facial. Only downside is 1/3 of bar 'melted' away in one week because of soft layer of product, then interior is harder lasting a long time. Maybe company can triple-mill soap for even use.
My daughter has exceptionally sensitive skin from eczema and allergies. This produce has given great relief to years of trial and error!

This bar has cleared my skin! I have dry, itchy, red skin because I am a competitive swimmer and I am also acne-prone because I am an adolescent. Nothing has ever cleared up my face without drying it out until this! I'm in love
I think that this soap has helped keep my contact dematitis under control.

avis.titre: VANICREAM IS A FANTASTIC PRODUCT - ESPECIALLY THOSE WITH VER

avis.titre: Best on the Market for Severe Dermatitis
avis.texte: I suffer from severe dermatitis/eczema and seborrheic dermatitis/dandruff. And more recently, an unexplained rising body temperature which flares up the eczema. It gets really bad in the summer and winter months. I get it mostly around my inner elbows, with a bad red rash appearing there that will peel and bleed in summer at its worst, and in the last few years it has spread to my chest and abdomen, back and legs, and my neck while sometimes my lower face. The only thing that will bring it down and work is Prednisone corticosteroid pills that reduce the inflammation, and then Triamcinolone Acetonide or similar corticosteroid topical creams or ointments that will take the rashes away. When I was a baby they found an allergy to Codeine, as well as bar soaps on me. So I had been using Aveeno body wash ever since, as colloidal oatmeal is supposed to be an eczema healer. But I was still getting flare-ups. I was getting it around my hands and wrists until I switched to a hypoallergenic free & clear hand-wash soap.Then my newly-appointed Dermatologist recommended Vanicream and gave me tiny samples of the cleansing bar, the Free & Clear shampoo with conditioner set, and a tiny tube of moisturizing skin cream. These products worked the best out of everything that I have tried before, which included but were not limited to: Neutrogena T/Gel; Head & Shoulders; Selsun Blue; Aveeno body wash & eczema creams; Hydrocortisone creams; Doctor-prescribed Triamcinolone Acetonide 0.1% Cream & Oin
Bar soap that removes mascara is great way to avoid the liquids carry on restriction for air travel. Happy!

im so thrilled to have had a chance to try this sample bar from my childs' pediatrician's office! it was to my surprise that it removed makeup well. I love products that are great for the whole family and plan to continue using this brand.

My daughters been using the cleansing bar for one week and her skin cleared up so fast! She stopped using the tetracycline cream for acne all together!
It's great-my son and I have eczema and it has worked wonders for us!!

using this product I have achieved the goal of eliminating dry skin; I have used the cleansing bar along with moisturizing cream.. Will purchase again. I am in chlorinated pool water 2-3 times a week and my skin had been dry and began to itch when I broke out in skin rashes. These products have been most beneficial for me.
I love this soap! I feel so much more cleaner without all the harsh chemicals and fragrances.

Only bar soap I will use – cleans well, no fragrance and no red itchy rashy skin afterwards.
This is the best for sensitive skin, no itchy skin or irritation. Only stuff I use now.
